art_direction: high-key silver-white and ice-blue glass architectural cutaway, shallow realistic material depth, clear processing modules with visible content-relevant interiors, dark navy attached labels and restrained cyan directional tracks on a white background
palette: white #FCFDFF, silver #DDE5EE, dark navy #132C55, ice blue #C9EFFF and cyan #14B8D4
typography: Projection-readable Chinese labels in solid dark ink, natural word spacing and semantic line breaks; keep texture, highlights and routing separate from letterforms.
materials: clear and frosted silver glass, thin precise edges, restrained blue refraction and small soft studio shadows

anchors.prompt: one fine ice-blue glass seam on the boundary of a meaningful authored component, away from lettering

text_layout: Prioritize authored component labels and relationships. Include a title only when supplied in exact_text, with hierarchy set by the page task. Keep reusable diagram headings outside the illustration when the page provides them; do not invent a teaching-reference subtitle or fixed title band.
contrast: Solid navy text on quiet white or warm-white fields; material highlights and line hatching remain outside letterforms.
avoid: decorative objects unrelated to the content
extra text not in exact_text
invented graph nodes, connections or feedback loops
